labels: the first bend of the Windward Road

fw_feed_below.accept_append: The best of the wash beds are under the Seam, north-west of the ramp foot, where the elk graze them down.

fw_the_anvil.accept_append: The Anvil is the great flat rock at the far west end of the floor, past Needle's Eye - which is where you will start meeting rooktenders.
labels: the scree at the foot of the Anvil

fw_at_the_ramp_foot.accept_append: Their wranglers hold the kodo back at Broadback, south-west of the ramp. Go that far.

sub: There is clay in the salt pans east of here, two days closer.
There is clay in the salt pans south of the ramp, two days closer.
sub_accept: Dig me seven good sacks off the pans at Saltwatch.
Dig me good sacks off the pans at Saltwatch, south of the ramp foot.
Go out to the hollow and stand
Go out to Dryhollow, south of the ramp beyond the salt pans, and stand

fw_the_glass_pan.accept_append: The glass pan is at the south edge of Dryhollow - south of the ramp, on past Saltwatch.

fw_pale_wood_wrong_wood.accept_append: The flood brings aspen down every year and the Drowning Floor keeps it. The cave mouth is at the foot of Broadback, west of the ramp, and the blind kodo bed on the stacks.

fw_the_drowned.accept_append: They are in the Drowning Floor, the cave at the foot of Broadback, west of the ramp.

fw_yearmaw.accept_append: The Drowning Floor. The mouth is at the foot of Broadback, west of the ramp, and the sump is as far down as it goes.

labels: the mouth of the wash at Broadback
